principle.name: Internal-Only Acceptance Criteria
principle.description: Acceptance criteria are strictly private internal checklists for Roo to evaluate fix correctness. They must never be included in GitHub issues or public artifacts.
principle.rationale: Keeps public issues clean for third parties while giving Roo precise validation criteria.

principle.name: Mandatory User Confirmation Gates
principle.description: Always pause and ask the user before attempting a fix and before committing/closing an issue.
principle.rationale: Ensures human-in-the-loop control over code modifications and issue lifecycle.

principle.name: Preserve Issue Descriptions
principle.description: Never overwrite an existing GitHub issue body with resolution notes or closing comments. Leave original issue text pristine.
principle.rationale: Prevents destroying historical bug context and reproduction steps.

convention.rule: Name feature/fix branches using the issue number format
Include issue references in commit titles or bodies

category.name: before_issue_creation
category.item: Check for duplicate open or closed issues
Verify acceptance criteria are excluded from public issue markdown
Get user approval on the drafted issue markdown

category.name: before_fixing
category.item: Ask user explicitly if we should attempt a fix

category.name: before_closing_issue
category.item: Ask user explicitly to review fix diff and test results
Ensure commit references the correct issue number
Close issue without overwriting the original issue description
